title: UI Runway weekly blitz - 2027-04-11
content:
Quick capture from the weekly UI Runway blitz (short, messy)

Date: 2027-04-11
Attendees: Maya, Arjun, Ruth, Benji, Priya (plus periodic drops from telemetry and SRE)

Purpose: rapid sync on panel rollout progress, streaming UI glitch, and analytics telemetry gaps. Intended to be actionable — few decisions, clear handoffs.

Top-line summary:
- Canary for Panel Streaming V2 (feature flag panel_stream_v2) at 10% user traffic. Initial telemetry looks okay for errors but p95 render time up ~120ms vs baseline. Suspect client-side hydration + new debounce logic.
- A spike in rejected rollout metrics observed for route /console/panels/load under heavy concurrency. Likely backpressure at the instrumentations layer (see INF-4721).
- Analytics pipeline: missed events from the new impression counter (batching window misconfigured). Impact: last 24h panel exposure numbers undercounted by ~14%.
- Blocking bug: streaming aborts when tokens include non-utf8 sequence (edge-case). Repro steps in PR 889.

Notes / raw observations:
- Benji: reproduced p95 regression locally when panel_stream_v2 enabled + Chrome 112, profile shows long tasks during initial DOM patch. Removing the new debounce around insertNode drops p95 back ~100ms. Could be a microtask starvation when we await remote KV cache fetch.
- Arjun: Server-side logs show a handful of 429s from rollout-gatekeeper for the panel route at 9:12–9:24UTC yesterday. The gatekeeper config bumped up rule matches after a spike in synthetic traffic from canary tests. We should add a soft-fallback that serves classic panel for gate hits.
- Ruth (analytics): ingestion client had batching.window_ms accidentally set to 60000 in prod config override instead of 6000. That explains the missing impression events for users who navigate quickly. Patch rolling out now.
- Priya (SRE): capacity tests for dedicated console nodes this morning pushed small VMs to 95% CPU when handling 1500 concurrent panel requests; autoscaler didn't kick due to a mis-tag on the ASG — fixed in infra PR. Related to this, the rollout should avoid full-traffic promotion until autoscaler metrics verified.

Immediate action items (owners + ETA):
- Benji: create experiment to toggle debounce timings and run A/B for 24h against 10% cohort. Add telemetry for first-paint-to-interactive. ETA 2027-04-13.
- Arjun: add soft-fallback in gatekeeper to route matched users to classic panel variant and implement a counting metric (gate_fallback_count). Small PR target today, deploy to canary. ETA 2027-04-12. Linked INF: INF-4721.
- Ruth: revert the batching.window_ms override in prod and re-ingest the missing impressions via backfill script. Coordinate with CS for any downstream reports. ETA 2027-04-12 (backfill run 4/13).
- Priya: verify autoscaler tag fix across regions and run controlled ramp to 3x concurrent load; report CPU scaling curve. ETA 2027-04-13.
- Maya: triage streaming-abort repro and add a regression test to the console integration suite to cover non-utf8 token cases. PR 889 has the starting patch; aim to merge after test added. ETA 2027-04-14.

Decisions made in meeting:
- Hold mainline rollout progression to 30% until A/B on debounce completes and gate fallback metric stable (<0.5% fallback).
- Prioritize analytics backfill before any further promotions (so product reports are correct for the last 48h).

Risks and unknowns:
- If debounce fix is insufficient, we may need to revert panel_stream_v2 and re-evaluate client-side architecture — this is time-consuming (2–3 sprints).
- Backfill might trigger downstream quotas in analytics storage if naive; Ruth to give estimate on rows and cost.
- Edge-case token encoding bug may indicate an upstream tokenizer mismatch in the SDK (need to audit).

Follow-ups / sync schedule:
- Short check-in Tuesday 2027-04-12 09:30 UTC (15m) to confirm fallbacks and batching fix deployments.
- Full retro/rollout decision Thursday 2027-04-14 16:00 UTC (30m) after AB results and autoscaler verification.

Misc notes / scratch ideas:
- Consider shipping a minimal client-side telemetry beacon that fires on first successful KV read to separate network vs render latency.
- Long-term: explore streaming frame-level metrics to detect chunking patterns that stall painting.

Attachments / refs:
- Repro notes for streaming abort: see PR 889 and linked test snippet in slack thread (slack:#console-panel-ops:msg-3f9a).
- Rollout gate config snapshot: confluence.redwood.ai/pages/Console-Runway-Design-2027 (section 'canary gating rules').
- Jira INF-4721 has the gatekeeper 429 traces and suggested fallback config.

TL;DR: small but actionable stack of fixes — debounce AB, gatekeeper fallback, analytics backfill, autoscaler verification, streaming-edge test. Aim for cautious promotion after Thursday;s AB checks.

Notes to self: keep this doc short and mutable — will convert to formal rollout blurb if we hit green next week.
summary: Canary at 10% shows p95 render regression and missing analytics events; action items assigned for debounce AB, gatekeeper fallback, batching config revert/backfill, autoscaler verification, and streaming-edge test. Hold further promotion until fixes validated.
